name: B10-0468/2026 – § 54 – Am 19
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: 54.Recognises that the EU Emissions Trading System(EU ETS) remains uniquely stringent compared to limited international carbon markets; underlines that its implementation presents severe structural challenges for European industry and escalates household affordability pressures;
